headline: Determined no aquifer registration needed for take-out restaurants at 838 Farmington Ave.
summary: The applicant first requested three take-out restaurants at 838 Farmington Ave, then revised the request to two. No regulated activities were found, so an aquifer protection registration is not required. The parking plan will be reviewed under a site plan with the Planning Commission.

plain_text:
Bristol Aquifer Protection Agency Special Meeting of August 10, 2026 
– 1 – 
 
 
BRISTOL AQUIFER PROTECTION AGENCY 
MINUTES 
SPECIAL MEETING OF MONDAY AUGUST 10, 2026 
By: Richard Goodwin, Acting Chairman Time: 7:33 P.M. Place: City Hall 
111 North Main St. 
Council Chambers 
First Floor 
ROLL CALL: 
 
MEMBERS NAME PRESENT ABSENT 
    
REGULAR MEMBERS: David White (Chairman) X  
 Richard Goodwin (Acting Chairman) X  
 John LaFreniere (Secretary) X  
 Richard Harlow X  
 Sara Mangiafico X  
    
ALTERNATE MEMBERS: Peter Caruso X  
 Morris Patton X  
 Jeffrey Hayden X  
    
STAFF: Robert M. Flanagan, AICP, City Planner X  
 
1. Call to Order 
Per the order of Acting Chairman Goodwin, the meeting was called to order at 7:33 P.M. 
2. Public Participation 
There was no public participation. 
3. Approval of Minutes: 
a. Special Meeting - July 13, 2026 
 
Acting Chairman Goodwin designated regular Commissioners Harlow, White, LaFreniere, Mangiafico and Goodwin to 
vote on the July 13, 2026, special meeting minutes. 
MOTION: Move to approve the minutes of the July 13, 2026, special meeting. 
By: Harlow  Seconded: Mangiafico. 
For: Harlow, White, LaFreniere, Mangiafico and Goodwin. 
Against: None. 
Abstained: None. 
 
4. New Business 
a. Application #APA-2026-03 — Determination of regulatory status for Three (3) Take- Out Restaurants at 838 
Farmington Ave; Assessor's Map 48, Lot 182; BG (General Business) zone; Ananta Properties, LLC/Anand 
Jaiswal, applicant / Vernon Properties, owner.
Bristol Aquifer Protection Agency Special Meeting of August 10, 2026 
– 2 – 
 
 
Acting Chairman Goodwin designated regular Commissioners Harlow, White, LaFreniere, Mangiafico and Goodwin to 
vote on Application #APA-2026-03. 
The Agency acknowledged receipt of the following items in their electronic packets: Project Narrative, undated, 838 
Farmington Avenue, Bristol, CT; CT Department of Public Health Notification Letter, dated October 14, 2021; Various 
GIS and Google Maps: GIS Map, 838 Farmington Avenue – Location Map, Map 48, Lot 182; GIS Map, 838 Farmington 
Avenue – Aquifer Protect Map, Map 48, Lot 182; GIS Map, 838 Farmington Avenue – Floodplain Map, Map 48, Lot 
182; GIS Map, 838 Farmington Avenue – Topography Map, Map 48, Lot 182; GIS Map, 838 Farmington Avenue – 
Zoning Map, BG (General Business) zone, Map 48, Lot 182; Google Map, 838 Farmington Avenue – Aerial 2023, Map, 
Map 48, Lot 182; Google Map, 838 Farmington Avenue – Aerial 2026, Map 48, Lot 182; Owner Authorization Letter, 
dated June 1, 2026; Application Summary, undated; Floor Plans; Elevation Drawings; Proposed Changes, E-Mail, 
dated July 22, 2026; from Anand Jaiswal to Robert Flanagan, City Planner; Electronic Maps, Existing Plan, Sheet A- 
100, prepared by Russell and Dawson, Inc., Architecture & Engineering, Inc. 
Mr. Flanagan reviewed the application had a request for 3 restaurants but the applicant has revised the application 
and now only 2 restaurants are proposed. The City Planner indicated a determination was needed for the request. It 
has been verified that the restaurant use is not a regulated activity. The City Planner stated that the applicant sent an 
application to the CT Dept. of Public Health because of the potential activity in the aquifer protection area.  
Commission inquiry: The City Planner confirmed the addition would not be constructed to the side of the building. 
Mr. Flanagan stated the parking plan will be reviewed under a Site Plan with the Planning Commission. 
MOTION: Move that based on information received at this meeting, the Bristol Aquifer Protection Agency 
determined that there are no regulated activities associated with Determination Application 2026-03 for 
Three (3) Take Out Restaurants at 838 Farmington Ave; Assessor's Map 48, Lot 182; BG (General 
Business) zone; Ananta Properties, LLC/Anand Jaiswal, applicant / Vernon Properties, owner, and 
therefore an Aquifer Protection Agency Registration is not required. 
1. Take Out Restaurant – 838 Farmington Ave; Assessor’s Map 48, Lot 128. 
By: Harlow Seconded: Mangiafico. 
For: Harlow, White, LaFreniere, Mangiafico and Goodwin. 
Against: None. 
Abstained: None. 
 
The determination of no regulated activity is accepted. 
 
5. Adjournment 
Acting Chairman Goodwin designated regular Agency Members Harlow, White, LaFreniere, Mangiafico and Goodwin 
to vote on the adjournment. 
MOTION: Move to adjourn at 7:40 P.M. 
By: Harlow Seconded: Mangiafico. 
For: Harlow, White, LaFreniere, Mangiafico and Goodwin. 
Against: None. 
Abstained: None. 
  
This meeting was recorded. 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Nancy King 
Recording Secretary 
 
 
  
David White, Chairman John LaFreniere, Secretary
